cohort: The study included 387 pregnant women with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) at Virgen del Rocio University Hospital.
finding: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) in pregnant women with PGDM was associated with lower weight gain, fewer prenatal visits, reduced cesarean section rates, and a lower incidence of macrosomia compared to self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG).
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections was significantly lower in the CGM group (53.1% vs. 58.2%, p = 0.03).
